what_it_does: Modern data centers need specialized hardware to handle networking, security, and monitoring tasks that would otherwise burden the main servers. Intel's IPU E2200 is a second-generation chip designed specifically for these infrastructure jobs—processing network packets, encrypting data, and collecting system telemetry. Rather than requiring the main compute chips (CPUs and GPUs) to stop their AI work and handle these chores, the IPU offloads them to dedicated hardware accelerators, then connects back via a high-speed data pathway to keep everything coordinated.
